description: Cyclic objects stored into Svelte $state: no failure, values readable through the cycle. Svelte proxies lazily, so an object reached back through a cycle is a new proxy (identity differs); natively nested values are proxied once, eagerly (recorded M3 deviation: lazy proxy snapshots)

knownGaps.semantics: Identity through a cycle back-reference: Svelte creates a new proxy on each lazy access path, the native proxy is shared (lazy proxy snapshots are not modelled)
